title: Bally's Corp
text: EX-10.1 2 ex101-tpgarescommitmentlet.htm EX-10.1 Document Exhibit 10.1 ARES MANAGEMENT LLC 1800 Avenue of the Stars, Suite 1400 Los Angeles, California 90067 TPG CREDIT MANAGEMENT, LLC 245 Park Avenue New York, New York 10167 CONFIDENTIAL November 17, 2026 Bally’s Corporation 100 Westminster Street Providence, RI 02903 Attention: SVP & Corporate Secretary Email: legal.na@ballys.com Bally’s Corporation – Term Loan Credit Facility To the addressee listed above: Reference is made to that certain Letter Agreement, dated as of September 30, 2026 (as amended, restated, amended and restated, supplemented and/or otherwise modified from time to time, the “ September Letter Agreement ”), by and between Bally’s Corporation, a Delaware corporation (the “ Borrower ” or “ you ”), and TPG Credit Management, LLC (“ TPG Credit ” and, acting on behalf of itself and/or one or more of its affiliates, managed funds and/or managed accounts, “ TPG ”). This letter agreement (including any schedules, annexes and exhibits hereto, this “ Commitment Letter ”) comprises the TPG Commitment (as defined in the September Letter Agreement) insofar as it provides for debt financing in the form of a new senior secured term loan facility 1 described in the term sheet attached hereto as Exhibit A (the “ Term Sheet ” and the transactions contemplated in the Term Sheet or otherwise in this Commitment Letter, the “ Transactions ”) in an aggregate principal amount of up to $500.0 million, plus the amount of certain fees in respect thereof, as set forth in the Term Sheet (the “ Credit Facility ”). Capitalized terms used but not defined herein have the meanings assigned to them in the Exhibits attached hereto. All references herein to Sections or Exhibits shall be construed to refer to Sections of this Commitment Letter and Exhibits to this Commitment Letter. In connection with the Transactions, (a) Ares Management LLC (acting on behalf of one or more affiliated or managed funds, investment vehicles and/or accounts as it deems appropriate, “ Ares ”) and TPG (together with Ares, each a “ Commitment Party ” and, collectively, the “ Commitment Parties ,” “ we ” or “ us ”) are each pleased to advise you of their several, but not joint, commitments (the “ Commitments ”) to provide the principal amount of the Credit Facility set forth opposite their respective names on Schedule 1 hereto and (b) each of the Commitment Parties is pleased to advise you of their several, but not joint, commitment to consent (and to cause their affiliated or managed funds, investment vehicles and accounts to consent) (in their roles as existing lenders under the Existing Term Loan Credit Agreement) to any amendment, waiver or other modification of the Existing Term Loan Credit Agreement as may be necessary or advisable (as reasonably agreed by the Commitment Parties and the Borrower) to permit the Transactions and the Exchange Offer (the “ Existing Term Loan Credit Agreement Amendment ”), (it being understood that the Commitment Parties’ commitments under this clause (b) shall be binding upon any successor, assignee or participant of any term loans under the Existing Term Loan Credit Agreement held by the Commitment Parties, their affiliated or managed funds, investment vehicles and accounts), in each case, on 1 NTD: At TPG Credit’s election (which may be made in its sole discretion), the Credit Facility may take the form of senior secured notes rather than term loans. the terms and subject to the conditions set forth or referred to in this Commitment Letter and subject only to the satisfaction or waiver of the conditions expressly set forth in Section 4 below. The Commitment Parties, in such capacity, are referred to herein as the “ Initial Lenders ”. 1. Titles and Roles . It is agreed that (a) TPG and Ares will act as joint lead arrangers (in such capacity, the “ Lead Arrangers ”) and as bookrunners for the Credit Facility, (b) Alter Domus (US) LLC (or such other agent as may be designated by the Lead Arrangers and consented to by the Borrower (such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed)) will act as administrative agent and collateral agent for the Credit Facility (in such capacities, the “ Agent ”), and (c) the Lead Arrangers will appear on the top left of the cover page of any marketing materials for the Credit Facility, and will perform the roles and responsibilities conventionally understood to be associated with such name placement. You agree that no other agents, co-agents, arrangers, managers or bookrunners will be appointed, and no other titles will be awarded, unless you and we shall so agree. No compensation (other than that expressly contemplated by this Commitment Letter) will be paid in connection with obtaining any Lender’s (as defined below) commitment to the Credit Facility unless you and the Lead Arrangers shall so agree. 2. Information . You hereby represent and warrant that (a) all written information and written data (excluding any projections, forecasts, financial estimates and other forward-looking information (the “ Projection Materials ”) and information of a general economic or general industry nature) that have been or will be made available to the Commitment Parties by or on behalf of you or any of your representatives (the “ Information ”), taken as a whole, does not or will not, when furnished, contain any untrue statement of a material fact or omit to state a material fact necessary in order to make the statements contained therein not materially misleading in light of the circumstances under which such statements are made (after giving effect to all supplements and updates thereto made prior to the Closing Date) and (b) any Projection Materials that have been or will be made available to the Lead Arrangers by or on behalf of you or any of your representatives have been or will be prepared in good faith based upon assumptions that are believed by you to be reasonable at the time any such Projection Materials are delivered to the Commitment Parties; it being understood that any such Projection Materials are subject to significant uncertainties and contingencies, many of which are beyond your control, that no assurance can be given that any particular projections will be realized and that actual results may differ and that such differences may be material and are not a guarantee of performance. You agree that, if at any time prior to the Closing Date, you become aware that any of the representations and warranties in the preceding sentence would be incorrect in any material respect if the Information and Projection Materials were being furnished, and such representations and warranties were being made, at such time, then you will promptly supplement the Information and such Projection Materials from time to time until the Closing Date so that such representations and warranties will be correct in all material respects under those circumstances, it being understood that such supplementation shall cure any breach of such representation and warranty. In arranging the Credit Facility, the Lead Arrangers (i) will be entitled to use and rely on the Information and the Projection Materials without responsibility for independent verification thereof, (ii) do not assume responsibility for the accuracy or completeness of any such Information or Projection Materials and (iii) will not make an appraisal of your assets or liabilities. The accuracy of the representations and compliance with the agreements in this Section 2 shall not be a condition to the Initial Lenders’ obligations to fund the Credit Facility on the Closing Date. 3. Fees . 2 As consideration for the commitments of the Initial Lenders hereunder, you agree to pay the fees set forth in Annex I of the Term Sheet. Once paid, such fees shall not be refundable under any circumstances, except as otherwise contemplated by the Term Sheet or agreed in writing by the parties hereto. 4. Conditions Precedent . The commitments of the Initial Lenders hereunder and the Lead Arrangers’ agreements to perform the services described herein are subject only to (a) the execution and delivery to the Agent by the Borrower and the Guarantors of definitive documentation with respect to the Credit Facility (the “ Facility Documentation ”), which shall be consistent with the Term Sheet, and (b) the other conditions set forth in Exhibit B ; it being understood that there are no conditions (implied or otherwise), including compliance with the terms of this Commitment Letter and the Facility Documentation, to the commitments hereunder, or to the availability and initial funding of the Credit Facility or to the Commitment Parties’ consent to the Existing Term Loan Credit Agreement Amendment, other than those conditions that are expressly stated in this Section 4 and Exhibit B to be conditions to the initial funding of the Term Loans on the Closing Date (and upon satisfaction or waiver by the Lead Arrangers of such conditions, the Commitment Parties shall execute the Facility Documentation and the Existing Term Loan Credit Agreement Amendment and the initial funding of the Term Loans under the Credit Facility shall occur). 5. Indemnification; Expenses . You agree, regardless of whether the Credit Facility closes, (a) to indemnify and hold harmless the Commitment Parties, the Lead Arrangers, the Agent, their respective affiliates and their and all of their affiliates’ respective directors, officers, employees, controlling persons, members, agents, attorneys, advisors and other representatives, successors and permitted assigns (each, an “ Indemnified Person ”) promptly upon written demand therefor, from and against all losses, claims, damages, liabilities and expenses arising out of or relating to this Commitment Letter, the Transactions or the Credit Facility or the use of proceeds thereof, or any claim, dispute, litigation, investigation or proceeding (“ Action ”) relating to any of the foregoing, regardless of whether any such Indemnified Person is a party thereto, whether or not such Action is brought by you, your equity holders, affiliates, creditors or any other person, and to reimburse each such Indemnified Person within thirty (30) days after receipt of a written request (together with reasonably detailed backup documentation supporting such reimbursement request) for any reasonable and documented out-of-pocket fees, disbursements and other charges of (i) one counsel to the Indemnified Persons taken as a whole, (ii) if necessary, one local counsel in each relevant material jurisdiction and (iii) in the case of any actual or reasonably perceived conflict of interest, additional counsel to each group of similarly situated Indemnified Persons taken as a whole, limited to one such additional counsel and one local counsel in each relevant material jurisdiction, incurred in connection with investigations, preparing to defend or defending, or providing evidence in or preparing to serve or serving as a witness with respect to, such Indemnified Person; provided that the foregoing indemnity will not, as to any Indemnified Person, apply to losses, claims, damages, liabilities and expenses that (x) arise from a dispute that does not involve any action or omission of you or any of your affiliates and is solely among the Indemnified Persons (other than any claims against an Indemnified Person in its capacity as, or in fulfilling its role as, the Agent or other agency role under the Facility Documentation) or (y) are found in a final, non-appealable judgment by a court of competent jurisdiction to have resulted from an Indemnified Person’s (or their affiliates or controlling persons or their respective directors, officers, employees, partners, advisors, agents or other representatives) bad faith, gross negligence, willful misconduct or material breach of the obligations of any such Indemnified Persons under the Facility Documentation and (b) to reimburse the Commitment Parties and the Agent for all reasonable and documented out-of-pocket expenses (including but not limited to expenses of the Commitment Parties’ due diligence investigation, travel expenses and reasonable fees, 3 disbursements and other charges of counsel to each Commitment Party identified in the Term Sheet (and of counsel to the Agent, which may be different) and, if necessary, of a single local counsel to each Commitment Party (and of counsel to the Agent, which may be different) in each relevant material jurisdiction), in each case, incurred in connection with the Credit Facility and the preparation of this Commitment Letter, the Facility Documentation and any security arrangements in connection therewith (collectively, the “ Expenses ”). Notwithstanding any other provision of this Commitment Letter, (i) you will have no obligation to indemnify any Indemnified Person for income taxes (or similar taxes) incurred by such person in connection with the fees or other compensation such person received in connection with this Commitment Letter, (ii) no Indemnified Person shall be liable for any damages arising from the use by others of information or other materials obtained through electronic, telecommunications or other information transmission systems, except to the extent such damages are found in a final non-appealable judgment of a court of competent jurisdiction to have resulted from the willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence of such Indemnified Person or any of its Related Indemnified Persons, and (iii) neither (x) any Indemnified Person or any of its Related Indemnified Persons, nor (y) you (or any of your subsidiaries or affiliates) shall be liable for any indirect, special, punitive or consequential damages (with respect to you in the case of this clause (y), other than in respect of any such damages incurred or paid by an Indemnified Person to a third party) in connection with this Commitment Letter, the Credit Facility (including the use of proceeds thereunder), the Transactions, or with respect to any activities related to the Credit Facility. You shall not be liable for any settlement of any Action effected without your prior written consent (which shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed), but if settled with your written consent or if there is a final and non-appealable judgment by a court of competent jurisdiction against an Indemnified Person in any such Action, you agree to indemnify and hold harmless each Indemnified Person in the manner set forth above. You shall not, without the prior written consent of the affected Indemnified Person (which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed), effect any settlement of any pending or threatened Action against such Indemnified Person in respect of which indemnity has been or could be sought hereunder by such Indemnified Person unless such settlement (i) includes an unconditional release of such Indemnified Person in form and substance reasonably satisfactory to such Indemnified Person from all liability or claims that are the subject matter of such Action and (ii) does not include any statement as to any admission of fault, culpability, wrongdoing or a failure to act by or on behalf of such Indemnified Person. Notwithstanding the foregoing, each Indemnified Person shall be obligated to refund and return promptly any and all amounts paid by you under this paragraph to such Indemnified Person for any such losses, claims, damages, liabilities and expenses to the extent a court of competent jurisdiction has determined in a final and non-appealable judgment that such Indemnified Person is not entitled to payment of such amounts in accordance with the terms hereof. For purposes hereof, a “ Related Indemnified Person ” of an Indemnified Person means (1) any controlling person or controlled affiliate of such Indemnified Person, (2) the respective directors, officers, or employees of such Indemnified Person or any of its controlling persons or controlled affiliates and (3) the respective agents or representatives of such Indemnified Person or any of its controlling persons or controlled affiliates, in the case of this clause (3), acting on behalf of or at the instructions of such Indemnified Person, controlling person or such controlled affiliate; provided that each reference to a controlled affiliate in this sentence pertains to a controlled affiliate involved in the negotiation or provision of this Commitment Letter or the Credit Facility. 6. Sharing Information; Absence of Fiduciary Relationship; Affiliate Activities . You acknowledge that (i) subject to Section 10 , the Commitment Parties may share with any of their affiliates, and such affiliates may share with the Commitment Parties, any information related to the Transactions or any of the matters contemplated hereby and (ii) the Commitment Parties and their respective affiliates may be providing debt financing, equity capital or other services (including, without limitation, 4 investment banking and financial advisory services, securities trading, hedging, financing and brokerage activities and financial planning and benefits counseling) to other companies in respect of which you may have conflicting interests. We will not furnish confidential information obtained from you by virtue of the transactions contemplated by this Commitment Letter or our other relationships with you to other companies (except as contemplated below). You also acknowledge that we do not have any obligation to use in connection with the transactions contemplated by this Commitment Letter, or to furnish to you, confidential information obtained by us or any of our respective affiliates from other companies. You further acknowledge and agree that (a) no fiduciary, advisory or agency relationship between you and any Commitment Party is intended to be or has been created in respect of any of the transactions contemplated by this Commitment Letter, irrespective of whether any of the Commitment Parties has advised or is advising you on other matters, (b) the Commitment Parties, on the one hand, and you, on the other hand, have an arm’s-length business relationship that does not directly or indirectly give rise to, nor do you rely on, any fiduciary duty on the part of any Commitment Party and you waive, to the fullest extent permitted by law, any claims you may have against us for breach of fiduciary duty or alleged breach of fiduciary duty in connection with the Transactions and agree that we will have no liability (whether direct or indirect) to you in respect of such a fiduciary duty claim or to any person asserting a fiduciary duty claim on your behalf, including equity holders, employees or creditors, (c) you are capable of evaluating and understanding, and you understand and accept, the risks and conditions of the Transactions, (d) you have been advised that no Commitment Party has any obligations to you or any of your affiliates with respect to any of the Transactions, and nothing in this Commitment Letter shall be construed to limit or prevent in any manner the Commitment Parties and their respective affiliates from (x) investing in or acquiring (or considering investing in or acquiring) any entity, even those engaged in the same or related business that you or your affiliates are engaged in (or proposed to be engaged in), regardless of whether the parties enter into the Facility Documentation or (y) carrying on any business with any party whatsoever, including without limitation, any competitor, supplier or customer of you or your affiliates, (e) you have consulted your own legal, accounting, regulatory and tax advisors to the extent you have deemed appropriate and (f) each Commitment Party has been, is and will be acting solely as a principal and, except as otherwise expressly agreed in writing by the relevant parties, has not been, is not and will not be acting as an advisor, agent or fiduciary for you, any of your affiliates or any other person or entity. In addition, the Commitment Parties may employ the services of their affiliates in providing certain services hereunder and may exchange with such affiliates in connection therewith information concerning you, and such affiliates shall be entitled to the benefits afforded to, and subject to the obligations of, the Commitment Parties under this Commitment Letter. You further acknowledge that each Commitment Party and its affiliates is an investment firm engaged in securities trading and brokerage activities as well as providing other financial services. In the ordinary course of business, each Commitment Party and its affiliates invest in, acquire debt and equity securities and assets of and/or provide other financial services in respect of which you may have conflicting interests regarding the Transactions and otherwise (and that we do not have an obligation to disclose any such interests, transactions or services to you). With respect to any securities and/or financial instruments so held by any Commitment Party, its affiliates or any of their respective customers, all rights in respect of such securities and financial instruments, including any voting rights, will be exercised by the holder of the rights, in its sole discretion. Additionally, you acknowledge and agree that we are not advising you as to any legal, tax, investment, accounting or regulatory matters in any jurisdiction (including, without limitation, with respect to any consents needed in connection with the transactions contemplated hereby). 7. Assignments; Amendments; Governing Law, Etc. 5 You acknowledge that (a) this Commitment Letter and the commitments hereunder (i) will not be assignable by you without the prior written consent of the Commitment Parties (and any attempted assignment without such consent shall be null and void), (ii) is intended to be solely for the benefit of the parties hereto (and Indemnified Persons), (iii) is not intended to confer any benefits upon, or create any rights in favor of, any person other than the parties hereto (and the Indemnified Persons) and (iv) is not intended to create a fiduciary relationship among the parties hereto, and (b) the Commitment Parties may assign all or a portion of their respective commitments hereunder to any party; provided that (i) you have provided us with prior written consent to such assignment (not to be unreasonably conditioned, withheld or delayed), except that no such consent pursuant to this subclause (i) will be required for any assignment to (A) a party that is a holder, or affiliate of a holder, of Senior Unsecured Notes (as such term is defined in the Existing Term Loan Credit Agreement) or (B) funds, investment vehicles or accounts managed or advised by TPG, Ares or their respective affiliates, (ii) no assignment of any commitment hereunder shall be made (and any purported assignment shall not be effective) to any Disqualified Lenders as of the date hereof under the Existing Term Loan Credit Agreement and such further competitors of the Borrower that the Borrower may reasonably designate hereafter, and (iii) (A) no assignment will relieve, release, reduce or novate any Commitment Party from any of its obligations hereunder unless and until the assignee shall have funded on the Closing Date the portion of the commitment so assigned and (B) each of the Commitment Parties shall retain exclusive control over all rights and obligations with respect to its commitments, including all rights with respect to consents, modifications, waivers and amendments, until the Closing Date has occurred and the Credit Facility has been funded. Subject to the limitations set forth in Section 6 , any and all services to be provided by any Commitment Party hereunder may be performed by or through any of such Commitment Party’s affiliates or branches. This Commitment Letter shall become effective upon execution and delivery of this Commitment Letter by all of the parties hereto. The effectiveness of this Commitment Letter shall have no effect on the validity or effectiveness of the September Letter Agreement, and TPG is entitled to the benefit of the indemnification, reimbursement (if applicable, but without duplication), sharing of information, absence of fiduciary relationships, submission to jurisdiction, governing law, venue, waiver of jury trial, confidentiality and all other provisions of this Commitment Letter and the September Letter Agreement, in accordance with their respective terms. This Commitment Letter may not be amended or any provision hereof waived or modified except by an instrument in writing signed by the Commitment Parties and you. This Commitment Letter may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original for all purposes, and all of which together shall constitute one agreement. Facsimile, portable document format (a/k/a “.PDF”) and any other electronic signature within the meaning of the Uniform Electronic Transactions Act, as amended (or any similar state law) on any counterpart hereof shall be deemed to be a true and legally binding signature with the same force and effect as an original. The words “execution”, “signed”, “signature”, “delivery” and words of like import in this Commitment Letter shall be deemed to include electronic signatures or the keeping of records in electronic form, each of which shall be of the same legal effect, validity or enforceability as a manually executed signature, physical delivery thereof or the use of a paper-based recordkeeping system, as the case may be, to the extent and as provided for in any applicable law, including the Federal Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act, the New York State Electronic Signatures and Records Act, or any other similar state laws based on the Uniform Electronic Transactions Act. Section headings used herein are for convenience of reference only, are not part of this Commitment Letter and are not to affect the construction of, or to be taken into consideration in interpreting, this Commitment Letter. This Commitment Letter supersedes all prior meetings, communications, representations, negotiations, contracts or agreements (including any prior drafts thereof) with respect to matters addressed herein, whether oral or written, and may not be contradicted by evidence of prior, contemporaneous or subsequent oral agreements of the parties hereto. There are no unwritten oral 6 agreements between the parties with respect to the matters addressed herein. THIS COMMITMENT LETTER, AND ANY CLAIM, CONTROVERSY OR DISPUTE ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS COMMITMENT LETTER, SHALL BE GOVERNED BY, CONSTRUED IN AND INTERPRETED IN ACCORDANCE WITH, THE LAWS OF THE STATE OF NEW YORK. Notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary, the Commitment Parties agree that in no event shall they or any of their respective controlled affiliates or any of their respective equity owners, directors, officers, partners, employees, consultants, advisors, agents and other representatives (collectively, “ Controlled Representatives ”), directly or indirectly, knowingly approach, discuss, solicit, initiate, entertain, permit, encourage, accept, respond to, support, or otherwise engage in any discussions regarding assigning, participating or otherwise transferring any of its commitments hereunder or any of the Term Loans with any third party (other than the Borrower or its Controlled Representatives or funds, investment vehicles or accounts managed or advised by the Commitment Parties or their respective affiliates) without the prior written consent (including via email) of the Borrower (not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed). 8. WAIVER OF JURY TRIAL . EACH OF YOU AND THE COMMITMENT PARTIES HEREBY IRREVOCABLY AGREES TO WAIVE TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY SUIT, ACTION, PROCEEDING, CLAIM, OR COUNTERCLAIM BROUGHT BY OR ON BEHALF OF ANY PARTY RELATED TO OR ARISING OUT OF THE TRANSACTIONS, THIS COMMITMENT LETTER OR THE PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES HEREUNDER OR THEREUNDER. 9. Jurisdiction . Each of the parties hereto hereby irrevocably and unconditionally (a) submits to the exclusive jurisdiction and venue of the state or federal courts located in the City and County of New York, regarding any suit, action, dispute or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Commitment Letter, the Transactions or the other transactions contemplated hereby or thereby, (b) waives any objection to the laying of venue in any suit, action or proceeding brought in any such court and any claim that any such suit, action or proceeding has been brought in an inconvenient forum and (c) agrees that a final judgment in any such action or proceeding shall be conclusive and may be enforced in other jurisdictions by suit on the judgment or in any other manner provided by law. Each of you, TPG and Ares agrees that service of any process, summons, notice or documents by registered mail addressed to you, TPG or Ares, as the case may be, shall be effective service of process for any suit, action or proceeding brought in any such court. 10. Confidentiality . This Commitment Letter is delivered to you on the understanding that neither this Commitment Letter nor the terms or substance hereof shall be disclosed by you, in whole or in part, directly or indirectly, to any other person or entity (including other lenders, underwriters, placement agents, advisors or any similar persons) except (a) to your affiliates (including Standard General, L.P.) or any of your and your affiliates’ respective officers, directors, employees, legal counsel, independent auditors, advisors and other experts or agents, (b) if the Commitment Parties provide prior written consent to such proposed disclosure, (c) solely with respect to this Commitment Letter, as may be required by the rules, regulations, schedules and forms of the SEC or any other governmental authority (including any gaming or racing authority) or regulator in connection with any filings made with the SEC or such other governmental authority or regulator in connection with the Transactions, (d) pursuant to the order of any court or administrative agency in any pending legal or administrative proceeding, or otherwise as required by applicable law, 7 regulation or compulsory legal process or as requested by a governmental authority (including any gaming or racing authority), or (e) to enforce any of your rights or remedies under this Commitment Letter or the Facility Documentation; provided that (i) you may disclose the Term Sheet to any rating agency in connection with the Transactions and (ii) this Commitment Letter and its contents (but not any specific fees or other economic terms set forth therein) may be disclosed to the extent that such information becomes publicly available other than by reason of disclosure by you or any of your affiliates in violation of this paragraph. The obligations under this paragraph shall automatically terminate in respect of the existence and contents of this Commitment Letter two (2) years following the earlier of (i) the Closing Date and (ii) the termination of this Commitment Letter in accordance with its terms. The Commitment Parties and their respective affiliates will use all non-public information regarding you and your subsidiaries provided to it or such affiliates by or on behalf of you hereunder solely for the purpose of evaluating, negotiating, consummating and/or administering the Transactions that are the subject of this Commitment Letter and shall treat confidentially all such information; provided that nothing in this Commitment Letter shall prevent any Commitment Party, any of its affiliates or any respective officers, directors, employees, legal counsel, independent auditors, advisors and other experts or agents of such Commitment Party or its affiliates (collectively, “ Representatives ”) from disclosing any such information (a) pursuant to the order of any court or administrative agency or otherwise as required by applicable law, legal process or regulation or as requested by a governmental authority (in which case such Commitment Party, to the extent permitted by law, rule or regulation and except in connection with any order or request as part of a regulatory or self-regulatory examination or an audit or examination conducted by bank accountants or regulators, agrees to inform you promptly of such disclosure), (b) upon the request or demand of any regulatory authority or self-regulatory body having jurisdiction or oversight over any Commitment Party or any of its affiliates (in which case, such Commitment Party, to the extent permitted by law, rule or regulation and except in connection with any order or request as part of a regulatory or self-regulatory examination or an audit or examination conducted by bank accountants or regulators, agrees to inform you promptly of such disclosure), (c) to the extent that such information becomes publicly available other than by reason of disclosure by a Commitment Party or any of its affiliates in violation of this paragraph, (d) to the extent that such information is received by any Commitment Party or any of its affiliates or any of their respective Representatives from a third party that is not, to the Commitment Party’s knowledge, subject to confidentiality obligations to you, (e) to the extent that such information is independently developed by any Commitment Party or its affiliates or any of their respective Representatives, in each case, so long as not based on information obtained in a manner that would otherwise violate this provision, (f) to any Representatives who need to know such information in connection with the Transactions and are informed of the confidential nature of such information (and the disclosing Commitment Party shall be responsible for its Representative’s compliance with this paragraph), (g) subject to the last paragraph of Section 7, to prospective Lenders, participants or assignees (or any of their respective advisors) or any potential counterparty (or any of their respective advisors) to any swap or derivative transaction relating to the Borrower or any of its subsidiaries or any of their respective obligations (in each case, other than Disqualified Lenders); provided that such disclosure shall be made subject to the acknowledgment and acceptance by such prospective Lender, participant or assignee that such information is being disseminated on a confidential basis (on substantially the terms set forth in this paragraph or as is otherwise reasonably acceptable to you and the Commitment Parties including, without limitation, as set forth in any confidential information memorandum or other marketing materials) in accordance with the standard syndication process of the Commitment Parties or market standards for dissemination of such type of information which shall in any event require “click through” or other affirmative action on the part of the recipient to access such confidential information, (h) for purposes of establishing a “due diligence” defense, (i) in consultation with you, to ratings agencies, (j) to enforce any of its rights or remedies under this Commitment Letter or the Facility Documentation, or (k) to any Commitment Party’s current or prospective investors who need to know such information in connection with the Transactions and who are 8 informed of the confidential nature of such information and are or have been advised of their obligation to keep such information confidential (and the disclosing Commitment Party shall be responsible for its investors’ and prospective investors’ compliance with this paragraph). The Commitment Parties’ obligations under this paragraph shall automatically terminate on the earlier of (i) two (2) years after the date hereof and (ii) the Closing Date (in which case, for this clause (ii), the confidentiality provisions in the Facility Documentation shall supersede the provisions of this paragraph). For the avoidance of doubt, nothing in the two preceding paragraphs shall prohibit any person from voluntarily disclosing or providing any information within the scope of the two preceding paragraphs to any governmental, regulatory or self-regulatory organization (any such entity, a “ Regulatory Authority ”), without any notification to any person, to the extent that any such prohibition on disclosure set forth in the two preceding paragraphs shall be prohibited by the laws or regulations applicable to such Regulatory Authority. 11. Surviving Provisions . The provisions of this Section 11 and the indemnification, confidentiality, jurisdiction, governing law, absence of advisory or fiduciary duty, waiver of jury trial, service of process, reimbursement and compensation (if applicable in accordance with the terms hereof), venue and information provisions contained herein shall remain in full force and effect regardless of whether the Facility Documentation shall be executed and delivered and notwithstanding the termination of this Commitment Letter or the Initial Lenders’ commitments hereunder and the Lead Arrangers’ agreements to provide the services described herein; provided that your obligations under this Commitment Letter, other than those relating to confidentiality, information, absence of advisory or fiduciary duty, compensation and reimbursement shall, to the extent covered by the Facility Documentation relating to the Credit Facility, automatically terminate and be superseded by the Facility Documentation relating to the Credit Facility upon the initial funding under the Credit Facility, and you shall no longer have any liability hereunder in connection therewith at such time (it being understood that your obligations under this Commitment Letter relating to reimbursement, compensation, confidentiality and absence of advisory or fiduciary duty shall survive the execution and delivery of such Facility Documentation to the extent set forth herein). You may terminate this Commitment Letter and/or the Initial Lenders’ commitments with respect to the Credit Facility (or a portion thereof) hereunder at any time subject to the provisions of the preceding sentence. 12. Patriot Act and Beneficial Ownership Regulation Notifications . We hereby notify you that pursuant to the requirements of the USA PATRIOT Act, Title III of Pub. L. 107-56 (signed into law October 26, 2001) (the “ Patriot Act ”) and 31 C.F.R. §1010.230 (the “ Beneficial Ownership Regulation ”), each Commitment Party and each Lender may be required to obtain, verify and record information that identifies the Borrower and each Guarantor, which information may include the name, address, tax identification number and other information regarding the Borrower and each Guarantor that will allow such Commitment Party or such Lender to identify the Borrower and each Guarantor in accordance with the Patriot Act and the Beneficial Ownership Regulation. This notice is given in accordance with the requirements of the Patriot Act and the Beneficial Ownership Regulation and is effective as to each Commitment Party and each Lender. 13. Acceptance and Termination . If the foregoing correctly sets forth our agreement, please indicate your acceptance of the terms of this Commitment Letter by returning to the Commitment Parties executed counterparts hereof not later than 11:59 p.m., New York City time, on November 30, 2026. The Commitment Parties’ commitments 9 hereunder and agreements contained herein will expire at such time in the event that the Commitment Parties have not received such executed counterparts in accordance with the immediately preceding sentence. This Commitment Letter and the commitments and undertakings of the Commitment Parties hereunder shall automatically terminate in the event that the funding of the Term Loans does not occur on or before December 31, 2026 (the “ Outside Date ”), unless the Commitment Parties shall, in their sole discretion, agree in writing to an extension; provided that the termination of any commitment pursuant to this sentence does not prejudice our or your rights and remedies in respect of any breach of this Commitment Letter; provided , further , that the Outside Date shall be automatically extended to February 15, 2027 so long as you (a) on or prior to December 31, 2026, deliver a written notice to the Commitment Parties certifying that the sole condition precedent (other than conditions that by their nature are to be satisfied on the Closing Date) to the funding of the Term Loans that is not (or will not) be satisfied as of December 31, 2026 is the receipt of one or more regulatory approvals required in connection with the Transactions (including any approval of a gaming or racing authority) (the “ Required Regulatory Approvals ”) and (b) are diligently and in good faith pursuing the Required Regulatory Approvals. Each of the parties hereto agrees that this Commitment Letter is a binding and enforceable agreement with respect to the subject matter contained herein or therein, it being acknowledged and agreed that the commitments provided hereunder are subject only to the conditions precedent as expressly provided herein. title: NOCERA, INC.
text: EX-10.1 2 nocera_ex1001.htm LETTER OF INTENT, DATED NOVEMBER 19, 2026, BETWEEN BITROCK LTD. AND NOCERA, INC. Exhibit 10.1 LETTER OF INTENT Regarding Cooperation on an Approximately 10 MW AI Data Center Project in Alberta This Letter of Intent (this “LOI”) is entered into as of the date on which it is signed by the last of the Parties to sign it, as indicated on the signature page (the “Effective Date”), by and between: BitRock Ltd. , a corporation incorporated under the laws of the Province of Alberta, Canada, with its registered office at 253 Nolancrest Cir NW, Calgary, Alberta T3R 0T5, Canada (“ BitRock ”); and Nocera, Inc. , a corporation incorporated under the laws of the State of Nevada, United States, whose common stock is listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market (ticker: NCRA), with its principal executive office at 3F (Building B), No. 185, Sec. 1, Datong Rd., Xizhi Dist., New Taipei City 221, Taiwan (R.O.C.) (“ Nocera ”). BitRock and Nocera are each referred to herein as a “Party” and together as the “Parties.” RECITALS (A) BitRock owns its own natural gas-fired power generation equipment and has obtained the permits required to generate and supply electricity in the Province of Alberta (collectively, the “Generation Rights”); (B) BitRock intends to build and operate an artificial intelligence data center with an IT load of approximately 10 MW, based on the above power generation equipment and the Generation Rights (the “Project”); and (C) Nocera is a publicly listed company focused on artificial intelligence infrastructure and wishes to participate in the Project by making a cash investment in BitRock. NOW, THEREFORE, following friendly negotiations, the Parties agree as follows: 1. FORM OF INVESTMENT 1.1 Nocera agrees, on the terms of this LOI, to invest directly in BitRock by subscribing in cash for newly issued shares of BitRock, and thereby to become a shareholder of BitRock. 1.2 Nocera’s investment funds shall be used solely for the construction of the Project. The specific use and disbursement of such funds shall be set out in the definitive investment agreement to be entered into between the Parties (the “Definitive Agreement”). 1 2. INVESTMENT AMOUNT AND VALUATION 2.1 The Parties agree that the investment shall be made on the basis of the following valuation: Item Amount Notes BitRock pre-money valuation Approximately US$28,000,000 Based on BitRock’s power generation equipment, the Generation Rights and land use rights Item Amount Notes Nocera investment amount Approximately US$22,000,000 Cash, to be used for the construction of the Project BitRock post-money valuation Approximately US$50,000,000 — 2.2 Nocera’s percentage shareholding in BitRock shall be determined as Nocera’s investment amount divided by BitRock’s post-money valuation. 2.3 If the results of Nocera’s due diligence differ materially from the information provided by BitRock, the Parties shall adjust BitRock’s pre-money valuation in accordance with such results. At the request of either Party, a valuation may be carried out by an independent valuation firm jointly selected by the Parties. 2.4 The instalments and disbursement conditions of Nocera’s investment (including any arrangements linked to construction progress) shall be set out in the Definitive Agreement. 3. OPERATIONS AND MANAGEMENT 3.1 BitRock shall be responsible for the construction management and day-to-day business operations of the Project. 3.2 As a shareholder of BitRock, Nocera shall have the right to appoint directors, to receive periodic financial reports and to participate in decisions on major matters, as further set out in the Definitive Agreement. 4. CUSTOMERS AND REVENUE 4.1 BitRock represents that certain customers have entered into memoranda of understanding (“MOUs”) with BitRock for computing power hosting services. 4.2 BitRock estimates that the net profit margin of the Project’s hosting revenue, after deduction of operating costs, will be approximately 25% to 30%. 4.3 BitRock shall ensure that all information it provides to Nocera is true, accurate and complete. The customer and revenue information described above shall be subject to, and governed by, the results of Nocera’s due diligence. 2 5. DUE DILIGENCE 5.1 From the Effective Date, Nocera may conduct due diligence on the Project and BitRock within the scope set out in the Annex. BitRock shall cooperate by providing the relevant documents. 5.2 Due diligence materials shall be provided on a rolling basis following receipt of written requests, without a fixed deadline. 5.3 Nocera’s investment funds shall be disbursed only after the completion of due diligence and the satisfaction of all conditions precedent set out in Section 9.2. 6. NON-EXCLUSIVITY, NON-CIRCUMVENTION AND NON-SOLICITATION 6.1 This LOI does not contain any exclusivity arrangement, and each Party may hold discussions with third parties. If either Party enters into substantive discussions with a third party regarding the Project, it shall notify the other Party. Such notice shall be limited to that fact, and the notifying Party shall not be required to disclose the name of the third party or the terms discussed. 6.2 During the term of this LOI and for six (6) months after its termination, neither Party shall use Confidential Information provided by the other Party to circumvent the other Party by transacting directly with the other Party’s land, power or equipment suppliers or customers in connection with the Project. 6.3 During the term of this LOI and for six (6) months after its termination, Nocera shall not, directly or indirectly, solicit or hire any director, officer, employee or consultant of BitRock, or induce any of them to terminate his or her employment or engagement with BitRock, except with the prior written consent of BitRock. 7. CONFIDENTIALITY AND DISCLOSURE 7.1 Each Party shall keep confidential the contents of this LOI and all non-public information obtained in connection with this LOI (collectively, “Confidential Information”). This confidentiality obligation shall continue for a period of three (3) years. 7.2 The Parties acknowledge that Nocera is a company listed on Nasdaq and may file or publicly announce this LOI as required by U.S. securities laws and stock exchange rules, and that such filing or announcement shall not constitute a breach of this LOI. However, any such filing or announcement shall be limited to the minimum content required by law, and the text thereof shall be provided to BitRock for review prior to release. BitRock shall provide its comments within a reasonable period of time. 7.3 Except as provided in Section 7.2, neither Party shall issue any press release regarding the Project without the prior consent of the other Party, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld. 3 8. EXPENSES 8.1 Each Party shall bear its own costs and expenses incurred in connection with this LOI and the due diligence, and neither Party shall be entitled to claim reimbursement from the other Party. 9. BINDING EFFECT, CONDITIONS PRECEDENT AND TERMINATION 9.1 This LOI shall be legally binding on both Parties upon execution. The Parties shall, in good faith, execute the Definitive Agreement as soon as practicable on the terms of this LOI. 9.2 Nocera’s obligation to make the investment is subject to the satisfaction of all of the following conditions precedent: (a) Nocera has completed its due diligence, and the results are reasonably satisfactory to Nocera; (b) the Parties have executed the Definitive Agreement; (c) each Party has obtained all necessary internal corporate approvals and regulatory approvals; and (d) the information provided by BitRock is true and accurate, and no material adverse change has occurred in BitRock’s business, assets or financial condition since the Effective Date. 9.3 This LOI shall remain in effect for sixty (60) days from the Effective Date. If due diligence is still in progress, the term may be extended by thirty (30) days with the written consent of both Parties. Upon execution of the Definitive Agreement, this LOI shall be superseded by the Definitive Agreement. 9.4 This LOI may be terminated in any of the following circumstances: (a) by mutual written agreement of the Parties; (b) by Nocera by written notice, if the conditions precedent set out in Section 9.2 have not all been satisfied within the term of this LOI; or (c) by the non-breaching Party by written notice, if the other Party commits a material breach of this LOI and fails to cure such breach within fifteen (15) days after receiving written notice from the non-breaching Party. 9.5 If this LOI is terminated under Section 9.4(a) or 9.4(b), neither Party shall be liable to the other Party for any damages. Section 6 (for the periods stated therein), Section 7, Section 10 and Section 11 shall survive the termination of this LOI. 4 10. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION 10.1 This LOI shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Province of Alberta and the federal laws of Canada applicable therein. 10.2 Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this LOI shall first be resolved through friendly negotiation between the Parties. If the dispute cannot be resolved through negotiation, it shall be submitted to arbitration in Calgary, Alberta, conducted in English before a sole arbitrator in accordance with the Arbitration Rules of the ADR Institute of Canada, Inc. (ADRIC). The arbitral award shall be final and binding on the Parties. 11. MISCELLANEOUS 11.1 This LOI is made in the Chinese and English languages. In the event of any inconsistency between the two versions, the English version shall prevail. 11.2 Any amendment to this LOI shall be made in writing and signed by both Parties. Neither Party may assign any of its rights or obligations under this LOI to any third party (including its affiliates or wholly-owned subsidiaries) without the prior written consent of the other Party. 11.3 This LOI may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which shall have the same legal effect as an original. [Remainder of page intentionally left blank. Signature page follows.] 5 SIGNATURE PAGE IN WITNESS WHEREOF, this LOI has been executed by the duly authorized representatives of the Parties as of the Effective Date. BITROCK LTD. By: /s/ Li Defeng Name: Li Defeng Title: Chief Executive Officer Date: 11/11/2026 NOCERA, INC. By: /s/ Song-Yuan Teng Name: Song-Yuan Teng Title: Asia Director Date: 11/19/2026 6 ANNEX – SCOPE OF DUE DILIGENCE BitRock shall provide the documents in its possession or reasonably available to it. No. Item Content 1 Corporate and Shareholding BitRock’s corporate registration records, articles, current shareholders and shareholding structure; the registered holder of the power generation equipment and the Generation Rights 2 Generation Rights Approval documents or application status of the power generation and supply permits (including AUC and EPEA approvals) 3 Generation Equipment Equipment list, ownership or purchase order documents, capacity and redundancy configuration 4 Site and Gas Supply Title or land use rights documents for the Project site; natural gas supply arrangements 5 Construction Construction budget, construction schedule and major contractors 6 Customers Signed hosting MOUs or contracts and pricing terms 7 Financial BitRock’s financial statements, financial model (including the calculation basis for the 25%–30% net profit margin), use-of-funds plan, and all existing liabilities and guarantees 8 Legal Litigation, regulatory investigations and other material legal matters 7
