title: Everli Global Holdings Inc.
text: EX-10.3 4 ea031321702ex10-3.htm AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO SECURED PROMISSORY NOTE AND PLEDGE AGREEMENT, DATED NOVEMBER [--], 2026 AMONG EVERLI GLOBAL INC., MELAR ACQUISITION CORP. I , PALELLA HOLDINGS LLC, EVERLI S.P.A., EVERLI EUROPE S.R.L., MELAR CAPITAL GROUP LLC Exhibit 10.3 AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO SECURED PROMISSORY NOTE AND PLEDGE AGREEMENT This Amendment No. 1 (this “Amendment”) is dated as of November 20, 2026 among the following parties: Everli Global Inc., a Nevada corporation (“Maker”); Melar Acquisition Corp. I, a Cayman Islands exempted company (together with its successors following the Domestication and the Business Combination, “New Melar”); Palella Holdings LLC (“Holdings”) and Salvatore Palella (“Palella”), as Pledging Stockholders; Everli S.p.A. and Everli Europe S.r.l. (the “Subsidiary Guarantors”); and the Payees listed on Exhibit I to the Note. It amends the Secured Promissory Note and Pledge Agreement dated October 21, 2025 in the principal amount of $7,500,000 (as supplemented by the Acknowledgement Agreement dated May 22, 2026, the “Note”). Capitalized terms not defined in this Amendment (including in Section 9) have the meanings given in the Note. Maker has asked the Payees to extend the Maturity Date of the Note, and the Payees have agreed on the terms below. 1. Maturity, Interest and Prepayment. (a) Maturity. The Maturity Date in Section 3(a) of the Note is extended to January 31, 2027. This Section 1(a) takes effect when all parties have signed this Amendment and the Signing Shares have been transferred under Section 2(a), whether or not the Amendment Effective Date has occurred. The Payees waive any Event of Default arising solely from non-payment on the original Maturity Date. (b) Interest. Interest continues to accrue at 17.5% per annum under Section 2 of the Note. While an Event of Default is continuing, interest accrues on all outstanding Obligations at 20.5% per annum (the “Default Rate”). From and after the Closing Date, accrued interest is payable quarterly in arrears on the first Business Day of each calendar quarter and at maturity. The Payee Representative elects, at least two Trading Days before each payment date, whether interest is paid in cash, or in shares of Class A Common Stock valued at the Conversion Price (“Interest Shares”). Absent an election, interest is payable in cash, provided that any interest that is not paid shall be added to principal. The principal amount on the Amendment Effective Date is [$8,904,168.57], including capitalized interest to that date. (c) Prepayment . Maker may prepay the Note, before or after the Maturity Date, only on at least ten (10) Business Days’ written notice to the Payee Representative (a “Prepayment Notice”). During the notice period the Payees may convert all or any part of the Note, and the amount to be prepaid is reduced by any amount converted. If Maker does not pay the full amount stated in a Prepayment Notice (as may be reduced by any conversions) on the date stated, the Prepayment Notice is cancelled, the failure is an Event of Default, and the Payees’ conversion rights continue unaffected. This Section 1(c) does not apply to payments under Section 3(b) of the Note, payments under Section 4(d) of this Amendment, or payments after acceleration. (d) Financing sweep . Apart from the final tranche of $2 million to be made pursuant to Yorkville’s Note Purchase Agreement and the first $7.5 million of other financings from Yorkville (including the SEPA), Section 3(b) of the Note applies to any financing by Maker or New Melar, including any advance under the Yorkville Documents (in excess of the foregoing amounts), subject to Section 3(b) of the ICA. Notwithstanding the foregoing, for each sale of shares under the SEPA the proceeds of which are included in such $7.5 million, Maker shall, within two Business Days after receipt, apply at least 25% of the net proceeds to prepay the Note (the “SEPA Sweep”) and an equivalent amount of the net proceeds to prepay the Yorkville Notes, and the remaining proceeds are excluded from Section 3(b) of the Note. No Prepayment Notice is required for a payment under Section 3(b) of the Note or the SEPA Sweep. (e) SEPA reporting. Maker shall deliver to the Payee Representative a copy of each settlement document with respect to each advance notice under the SEPA within two Business Day after each SEPA settlement, a statement showing the number of shares sold, the purchase price, the gross proceeds, all deductions, the net proceeds and the SEPA Sweep amount, with the SEPA Sweep paid at the same time. For the SEPA Sweep, “net proceeds” means gross proceeds less only the discount and fees that Yorkville actually deducts under the SEPA. 2. Inducement Shares. In consideration of the extension: (a) Signing Shares. Before the Effective Time, Holdings shall transfer the Signing Shares to the Payees, or to such designee of the Payee Representative as it directs in writing (which designee shall not be an affiliate of New Melar). The “Signing Shares” are the number of shares of Maker common stock that convert in the Business Combination into 300,000 shares of Class A Common Stock. They are to be transferred free and clear of all liens (subject to Section 7(c)(ii)) and of any lock-up, leak-out or similar restriction. Holdings represents that it has good and marketable title to the Signing Shares and full power to transfer them. Maker, New Melar and Holdings shall deliver, and New Melar shall cause the Sponsor to deliver, any waiver, release or instruction needed (including under the Lock-Up Agreement dated July 30, 2025 among the SPAC, the Sponsor and Holdings) to give effect to this Section 2(a). The Payees release their own security interest in the Signing Shares effective on that transfer, and only for that purpose. (b) Additional Inducement Shares. New Melar shall issue to the Payees 500,000 shares of Class A Common Stock (the “Additional Inducement Shares”) on the Closing Date. New Melar shall issue them in book-entry form in the name of the Transfer Agent (or another escrow agent reasonably acceptable to the Payee Representative), as escrow agent for the Payees. The escrow agent shall release them to the Payees on the first Business Day after January 13, 2027 unless Maker has repaid the Obligations in full in cash by January 13, 2027 (for this purpose, conversion of the Note in full before any Event of Default counts as repayment in full in cash; a partial conversion or partial payment does not), and otherwise return them to New Melar for cancellation. The escrow agent shall release the Additional Inducement Shares to the Payees upon written notice from the Payee Representative stating that the Obligations were not repaid in full in cash by January 13, 2027, without any further consent or instruction from Maker or New Melar, and shall return them to New Melar only upon written notice from the Payee Representative confirming repayment in full in cash, which notice the Payee Representative shall give promptly after repayment in full. The escrow terms shall be set out in the transfer agent instructions under Section 3(f). The Payees may not sell them while they are in escrow, but they are Registrable Securities under Section 4(a). These shares shall be fully earned on January 14, 2027 if the Note is not repaid in full in cash by January 13, 2027, and once earned, are not affected by any later prepayment, conversion or repayment of the Note. (c) Adjustments. All share numbers and prices in this Amendment adjust equitably for any stock split, reverse split, stock dividend, recapitalization or similar event. 3. Conversion. Sections 4 and 20 of the Note are amended as follows. (a) Conversion Price. Until the Variable Price Date, the “Conversion Price” is the Fixed Conversion Price (defined below). From and after the Variable Price Date, the “Conversion Price” is the lower of (i) $11.00, as adjusted under the Note and Section 2(c) (the “Fixed Conversion Price”), and (ii) 95% of the lowest daily VWAP during the ten Trading Days before the Conversion Date or other date of determination (the “Variable Price”). From and after an Event of Default, whether or not later cured, the Variable Price is 80% of the lowest daily VWAP during the twenty Trading Days before the Conversion Date; provided, however, in no event shall the Variable Price be lower than 20% of the lower of (x) the Nasdaq official closing price of the Class A Common Stock on the Trading Day immediately before the Variable Price Date and (y) the average Nasdaq official closing price of the Class A Common Stock for the five Trading Days immediately before the Variable Price Date, in each case as adjusted under Section 2(c) (the “Floor Price”). The “Variable Price Date” is the earliest of (A) January 13, 2027, (B) the date the registration statement under Section 4(a) is declared effective and (C) the occurrence of an Event of Default. (b) Full ratchet. Suppose Maker or New Melar issues Class A Common Stock at a price below the Fixed Conversion Price, or securities convertible into New Melar Class A Common Stock (other than the Issuance of any shares under the SEPA or the Yorkville Notes, or on conversion, exercise or exchange of securities outstanding on the Amendment Effective Date in accordance with their terms as in effect on that date) at a conversion or exercise price below the Fixed Conversion Price. The Fixed Conversion Price is then reduced to that price. This does not apply to issuances under the Incentive Plan or to stock splits and similar events. Convertible securities are treated as issued at the lowest price at which a share is issuable under them. New Melar shall promptly notify the Payee Representative of each adjustment. (c) Conversion Amount. The “Conversion Amount” includes principal (including the OID Discount and capitalized interest), accrued interest (including at the Default Rate), the monitoring fee, liquidated damages and reimbursable costs. (d) Delivery and buy-in. New Melar shall deliver Conversion Shares and Interest Shares through DWAC by the first Trading Day after a Conversion Notice. It shall also, at its own cost: (i) if it fails to deliver and the Payee buys shares to cover a sale (a “Buy-In”), within three Business Days either pay the Payee’s purchase price, or deliver the shares and pay the excess of that price over the closing price on the Conversion Date (Maker and New Melar are jointly and severally liable); (ii) cause its counsel to deliver legend-removal opinions within two Trading Days of request, and reimburse the Payees’ costs of obtaining an opinion if it does not; (iii) round fractional shares up and pay any transfer, stamp or similar taxes on issuance; and (iv) if it fails to deliver Conversion Shares or Interest Shares by the first Trading Day after a Conversion Notice, pay the Payee, as liquidated damages and not as a penalty, the greater of $1,000 per day and $25 per Trading Day for each $1,000 of undelivered shares (valued at the VWAP on the Conversion Date), increasing to $35 per Trading Day from the fifth Trading Day, until the shares are delivered or the Payee withdraws the Conversion Notice, payable in cash on demand or, at the Payee’s election, added to principal. (e) Ownership limit. The beneficial ownership limit is 4.99%, which a Payee may raise to 9.99% on 61 days’ notice. Any amount that cannot be converted because of that limit remains outstanding. (f) Share reserve. So long as any portion of the Note remains outstanding, New Melar shall keep reserved for issuance under the Note, out of its authorized but unissued Class A Common Stock, not less than 400% of the shares then issuable on conversion (the “Required Reserve”). If the reserved shares are at any time less than the Required Reserve, New Melar shall within two Business Days instruct the Transfer Agent in writing to increase the reserve to the Required Reserve. If its authorized shares are insufficient, it shall within 30 days call a stockholder meeting (or seek written consent) to increase them, with its board recommending approval, and shall increase the reserve to the Required Reserve within two Business Days after the increase is approved. On the Closing Date, New Melar shall deliver irrevocable transfer agent instructions, countersigned by the Transfer Agent, which may not be revoked or modified without the Payee Representative’s written consent. 2 (g) Price Floor. The Payees may convert the Note at any time at the Conversion Price. From the Amendment Effective Date until January 13, 2027 (the “Price Floor Period”), the Payees shall not sell any Conversion Shares, Interest Shares or Additional Inducement Shares at a price below $11.00 per share (as adjusted under Section 2(c)), and shall not hedge them. This does not apply to the Signing Shares. The Price Floor Period ends early on the earliest of (i) an Event of Default, (ii) Maker giving a Prepayment Notice, and (iii) Yorkville converting any Yorkville Note at a price below $11.00 per share, or selling any shares received on conversion of a Yorkville Note at a price below $11.00 per share, during the Price Floor Period. If Maker or New Melar releases, waives or shortens any lock-up, sale restriction or price floor for any other holder of shares or convertible securities of Maker or New Melar (including Holdings, Palella or the Sponsor), or otherwise permits any such holder to convert or sell earlier, or on better terms, than the Payees may under this Section 3(g), the same release, waiver or terms apply automatically to the Payees, and the Price Floor Period ends to the same extent. Maker shall notify the Payee Representative of any such release, waiver or permission within one Business Day. A sale by a Payee in breach of this Section 3(g) is not an Event of Default or a default under the Note or any Yorkville Document, and Maker’s sole remedy for that breach is recovery of the difference between $11.00 and the actual sale price for the shares sold below $11.00. 4. Registration, Nasdaq Approval and Amortization. (a) Registration. New Melar shall file a Form S-1 covering the resale of all Registrable Securities within 15 days after the Closing Date. It shall cause the S-1 to be effective within 60 days after the Closing Date and to remain continuously effective until all Registrable Securities are sold or may be sold without restriction under Rule 144. Provided that in the event that the SEC comments that not all of the securities included in the registration statement filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC“) may be included in such registration statement, New Melar shall reduce the number of all securities (including the Registrable Securities) on a pro-rata basis until the total such securities included in such registration statement is an amount that New Melar reasonably believes will be acceptable to the SEC. Any Registrable Securities not included in such registration shall be included in a subsequent registration statement to be filed not later than twenty (20) days after the first date on which the Company is then permitted to file such subsequent registration statement with the SEC. If New Melar fails to do so, that failure is an Amortization Event under Section 4(d)(i) (and an Event of Default under Section 5(c)(xii)), and no liquidated damages are payable. The Payees have piggyback rights on any other registration statement (other than on Form S-4 or S-8). No Payee or Registrable Security is subject to any lock-up, including under any registration rights agreement entered into for the Business Combination, and Maker and New Melar shall not agree to any such restriction. New Melar bears all registration expenses (other than selling commissions) and shall indemnify the Payees on customary terms. (b) Exchange Cap. Until Stockholder Approval is effective, New Melar shall not issue shares under the Note above the Exchange Cap. Any amount that cannot be converted remains outstanding. The Exchange Cap applies in addition to the ownership limit. (c) Stockholder Approval. New Melar shall obtain stockholder approval under Nasdaq Rules 5635(c) and 5635(d) for all shares issuable under the Note without regard to the Exchange Cap (“Stockholder Approval”). It shall do so by written consent of Holdings within 10 Business Days after the Closing Date, with a Schedule 14C information statement filed within 15 days and effective within 65 days after the Closing Date. Holdings agrees to give that consent, and Maker and New Melar shall cause Holdings and the Sponsor to vote for it. (d) Amortization Events. Each of the following is an “Amortization Event”, cured as stated: (i) the Form S-1 is not filed or not effective by the deadlines in Section 4(a), or after it is effective the Payees cannot resell under it for 10 consecutive Trading Days (cured when the Payees can resell under an effective registration statement or can resell all Registrable Securities under Rule 144 without restriction); (ii) after the deadline for Stockholder Approval, 99% of the shares available to the Payees under the Exchange Cap (after the allocation under Section 8, if effective) have been issued, or any conversion is refused because of it (cured when Stockholder Approval is effective or the cap no longer applies); (iii) Stockholder Approval is not effective within 65 days after the Closing Date, or any approval is obtained for Yorkville first (cured when Stockholder Approval is effective); and 3 (iv) the daily VWAP is less than the Floor Price then in effect for any five Trading Days during a period of seven consecutive Trading Days (cured on the tenth consecutive Trading Day on which the daily VWAP is greater than the Floor Price then in effect). Beginning on the seventh Trading Day after an Amortization Event, and monthly until it is cured, Maker shall pay in cash $1,000,000 of principal (or, if less, the outstanding principal), plus a premium of 10% of that principal, plus accrued interest. 5. Events of Default and Covenants. Sections 8 and 9 of the Note are amended as follows. (a) Payment default. Non-payment is an Event of Default with no notice required. This replaces the existing notice and cure period. (b) Acceleration. Other than for an Event of Default under Section 8(iii) of the Note (bankruptcy and insolvency), which accelerates automatically, the Payee Representative may by written notice declare the Acceleration Amount immediately due. The “Acceleration Amount” is 110% of outstanding principal plus accrued interest and all other Obligations. The Payees may still convert after an Event of Default. (c) Additional Events of Default. Each of the following is also an Event of Default: (i) a late periodic report, or failure to file Form 10 information within four Business Days after the Closing Date; (ii) Class A Common Stock not being approved for Nasdaq listing at the closing of the Business Combination, or the Class A Common Stock thereafter ceasing to be listed on Nasdaq or another national securities exchange, or trading in it being halted or suspended for more than five consecutive Trading Days, or New Melar receiving a notice of failure to satisfy any continued listing requirement that is not cured within the period allowed by the exchange; (iii) judgments above $500,000 not bonded, discharged or stayed within 30 days; (v) failure to deliver Conversion Shares within two Trading Days, New Melar announcing that it will not honor a Conversion Notice, or failure to pay a Buy-In within five Business Days; (vi) failure to obtain Stockholder Approval within 120 days after the Closing Date; (vii) failure to deliver the New Melar joinder, the Additional Inducement Shares (into escrow under Section 2(b)) or the transfer agent instructions within one Business Day after the Closing Date, or to release any earned Additional Inducement Shares from escrow within one Business Day after January 13, 2027; (viii) any breach by New Melar of the Note or this Amendment that is not cured as provided in Section 8(ii) of the Note; (ix) after the Closing Date, the bankruptcy, insolvency, winding-up and change-of-control events in Section 8 of the Note applying to New Melar and its subsidiaries, or Maker ceasing to be a wholly owned subsidiary of New Melar; (x) a DTC chill or other DTC restriction on the Class A Common Stock not remedied within two weeks, the Class A Common Stock ceasing to be eligible for DTC’s FAST or DWAC programs, or any stop-transfer instruction on shares held by or issuable to the Payees; (xi) failure to maintain the share reserve or the authorized shares required by Section 3(f), or New Melar replacing its Transfer Agent without the successor first signing instructions in the form required by Section 3(f); (xii) the Form S-1 not filed or not effective by the deadlines in Section 4(a), or not available for resale for 10 consecutive Trading Days after it is effective; (xiii) any default under the Subsidiary Guaranty, the ICA or the transfer agent instructions, or any lien, pledge or guaranty under the Note or this Amendment ceasing to be valid, perfected and first priority (subject only to the ICA), or any party contesting it; (xiv) failure to deliver the security interest, filings or instruments required by Section 6(d) when required; and (xv) any event or condition that has, or would reasonably be expected to have, a material adverse effect on the business, assets or condition of Maker and New Melar taken as a whole, or on their ability to perform the Note or this Amendment. (d) Covenants. Section 9(a) of the Note applies also to New Melar and its subsidiaries (with SPAC redemptions permitted). Without Payee Representative consent, neither Maker, New Melar nor any of their subsidiaries shall enter into any Variable Rate Transaction other than with the Payees, the SEPA, or under the Yorkville Documents as in effect on the Amendment Effective Date, with Yorkville. The Yorkville Notes outstanding on the Amendment Effective Date, and payments on them permitted by the ICA, are permitted. The Payees consent to the repayment at the closing of the Business Combination of working capital loans made to the SPAC by the Sponsor or its affiliates, up to $[●]. 4 (e) Monitoring fee. While an Event of Default continues, Maker shall pay a monitoring fee of $10,000 per month, added to principal if unpaid. (f) Most favored nation. Any term granted to Yorkville, or to any other holder of debt or equity-linked securities of Maker or New Melar, after today that is more favorable than the corresponding term of the Note automatically applies to the Note. This covers pricing, premiums, defaults, registration timing, liquidated damages, stockholder approval covenants and Exchange Cap terms. Maker shall notify the Payee Representative of any such term within two Business Days. (g) Notice and inspection. Maker shall notify the Payee Representative of any Event of Default within two Business Days. The inspection rights in Section 9 of the Note extend to New Melar and its subsidiaries. 6. Guaranties and Pledge. (a) Ratification. Holdings, Palella and each Subsidiary Guarantor ratify their guaranties and pledges, which secure the Note as amended (including all obligations of New Melar under it). (b) New Melar. Effective at the Closing Date, New Melar guarantees all Obligations as primary obligor. It does so on the same terms and with the same waivers as the Guaranty in Section 5 of the Note, ranking pari passu with any guaranty it gives of the Yorkville Notes. New Melar is also directly bound by the Note’s conversion, share delivery, registration and approval obligations, and shall deliver a written joinder on the Closing Date. The Note survives the Business Combination as an obligation of Maker. (c) Pledge continues. The shares of New Melar that Holdings receives in the Business Combination for its Pledged Shares remain Pledged Shares without further action. Within two Business Days after the Closing Date, Holdings shall deliver any stock powers, control agreements or other instruments the Payee Representative requests to perfect that pledge. Holdings may vote its shares in favor of the Stockholder Approval. (d) New Melar security interest. Effective at the Closing Date, to secure the Obligations, New Melar grants the Payees a continuing security interest in and lien upon its property and assets, now owned or hereafter acquired, to the extent as had been granted by Maker as set forth in Section 6(a) of the Note, including all shares of capital stock and other equity interests of Maker and of New Melar’s other subsidiaries, on the terms of Section 6(a) of the Note as if New Melar were the Maker. That security interest ranks pari passu with any security interest New Melar grants to Yorkville and is otherwise senior, subject only to the liens excepted in Section 6(a) of the Note and the liens of Yorkville as set forth in the ICA. New Melar authorizes the Payee Representative to file financing statements in Nevada and any other jurisdiction, and within two Business Days after the Closing Date shall deliver any certificates, allonges and stock powers for the shares of Maker to Yorkville, as collateral agent for possessory collateral under Section 2.03(d) of the ICA. 7. Effectiveness; Conditions; General. (a) Effectiveness. Except for Section 1(a), this Amendment becomes effective on the date (the “Amendment Effective Date”) on which each condition in Section 7(b) and Section 7(c) has been satisfied, or waived in writing by the Payee Representative. If the Amendment Effective Date has not occurred by November 30, 2026, the Payee Representative may declare an Event of Default, and the extension under Section 1(a) terminates and the Maturity Date reverts to October 21, 2026. The parties shall deliver their signature pages to counsel for the Payees, to be held in escrow and released only at the Effective Time. If the Effective Time has not occurred by November 30, 2026, the signature pages shall be returned, any Signing Shares transferred shall be returned to Holdings, and this Amendment shall have no effect. (b) Conditions. The conditions are that (i) all parties have signed this Amendment; (ii) the Signing Shares have been transferred under Section 2(a); and (iii) New Melar has delivered a binding undertaking to deliver the transfer agent instructions on the Closing Date. (c) Yorkville conditions. Yorkville shall also have signed a consent and agreement with the Payee Representative (the “Yorkville Consent”) in a form to be agreed upon between Yorkville and the Payee Representative. (d) No novation; ICA. This Amendment does not effect a novation. All liens, pledges and guaranties continue to secure the Note as amended. Except as amended here, the Note remains in full force. This Amendment is intended to comply with, and is subject to, the ICA. (e) Costs. Maker shall pay the Payees’ reasonable legal fees and expenses for this Amendment, which are Obligations. (f) Other terms. Sections 11 (assignment), 13 (governing law and jurisdiction), 14 (entire agreement) and 21 (counterparts) of the Note apply to this Amendment and to New Melar. The entire agreement clause excludes the ICA and the Merger Agreement. (g) Trust account. The trust account waiver in Section 19 of the Note terminates on the Closing Date. It does not limit any right of the Payees against New Melar or its assets after the Closing Date, including funds released from the trust account. 5 (h) Payee Representative; assignment. Section 6(e) of the Note is amended so that the Payee Representative is the Payee or Payees holding a majority of the outstanding Loan from time to time, or the person they designate in writing. Maker, New Melar, Holdings and Palella acknowledge that the Payees may transfer the Note under Section 11 of the Note, and that on any transfer the transferee succeeds to all rights of the Payees and the Payee Representative under the Note, this Amendment, the Subsidiary Guaranty and the ICA, with Exhibit I to the Note updated accordingly. 8. Yorkville Parity and ICA. The Note and the Yorkville Notes remain pari passu, except that SEPA Sweep payments are retained by the Payees and not shared with Yorkville, and no amendment of the Yorkville Documents may give Yorkville priority without Payee Representative consent. 9. Certain Definitions. In this Amendment: “Class A Common Stock” means the Class A ordinary shares of the SPAC and, after the Domestication and the Business Combination, the Class A common stock of New Melar. Each reference in the Note to “SPAC” or “SPAC Class A Common Stock” refers to New Melar or Class A Common Stock, as applicable. “Closing Date” means the date the Business Combination is consummated. “Conversion Shares” means shares of Class A Common Stock issued on conversion of the Note. “Default Rate” has the meaning given in Section 1(b). “Effective Time” means the time the merger of Maker under the Merger Agreement becomes effective. “Exchange Cap” means 19.99% of the shares of Class A Common Stock outstanding on the measurement date that Nasdaq applies to the Note under Rule 5635(d). “Floor Price” has the meaning given in Section 3(a). “ICA” means the Intercreditor Agreement dated May 8, 2026 among the SPAC, Melar Capital Group LLC, Yorkville, Maker, Palella and Holdings. “Incentive Plan” means New Melar’s 2026 equity incentive plan as in effect on the Closing Date. “Nasdaq” means The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC. “Price Floor Period” has the meaning given in Section 3(g). “Registrable Securities” means the Signing Shares (to the extent not freely tradeable), Additional Inducement Shares, Conversion Shares and Interest Shares. “SEPA” means the Standby Equity Purchase Agreement between New Melar and Yorkville contemplated by the Yorkville Documents. “SEPA Sweep” has the meaning given in Section 1(d). “Sponsor” means Melar Acquisition Sponsor I LLC. “Trading Day” means a day on which the Class A Common Stock trades on its principal market. “Transfer Agent” means the transfer agent for the Class A Common Stock. “Variable Price Date” has the meaning given in Section 3(a). “Variable Rate Transaction” means any issuance of equity or convertible securities at a price that varies with, or may be reset by reference to, the trading price of the Class A Common Stock, or under any equity line, at-the-market or forward purchase arrangement. “VWAP” means the daily dollar volume-weighted average price of the Class A Common Stock on its principal market, as reported by Bloomberg. “Yorkville” means YA II PN, Ltd. “Yorkville Consent” has the meaning given in Section 7(c). “Yorkville Documents” means the Note Purchase Agreement dated March 6, 2026 between Maker and Yorkville (as amended), the Yorkville Notes, the SEPA and the related documents. “Yorkville Notes” means the convertible promissory notes issued by Maker to Yorkville. [ Signature page follows ] 6 Signed as of the date first written above. EVERLI GLOBAL INC., as Maker MELAR ACQUISITION CORP. title: Everli Global Holdings Inc.
text: EX-10.4 5 ea031321702ex10-4.htm FOURTH AMENDMENT, DATED NOVEMBER 20, 2026, TO THE SECURED PROMISSORY NOTE AND PLEDGE AGREEMENT DATED AS OF AUGUST 18, 2025, AS AMENDED ON SEPTEMBER 12, 2025, SEPTEMBER 29, 2025 AND MARCH 30, 2026 Exhibit 10.4 FIFTH AMENDMENT TO AMENDED AND RESTATED SECURED PROMISSORY NOTE AND PLEDGE AGREEMENT This Fifth Amendment (this “Amendment”) is entered into as of November 20, 2026 by and among Everli Global Inc., a Nevada corporation (“Maker”), Melar Acquisition Corp. I, a Cayman Islands exempted company (“Payee”), and Palella Holdings, LLC (“Pledging Stockholder”). It amends the Amended and Restated Secured Promissory Note and Pledge Agreement dated as of August 18, 2025, as amended on September 12, 2025, September 29, 2025 and March 30, 2026 (the “Note”). Capitalized terms not defined here have the meanings given in the Note. Maker has asked Payee to extend the Maturity Date to March 31, 2027, and Payee has agreed on the terms below. 1. Extension of Maturity Date. Section 3 of the Note is amended so that the “Maturity Date” is March 31, 2027. For the avoidance of doubt, Clauses (i) and (iii) of Section 3 of the Note regarding any closing of the transactions contemplated by the Merger Agreement (the “Closing”) or Bridge Financing, respectively, no longer apply. 2. Original Issue Discount. On the date of this Amendment, an original issue discount (“OID”) equal to 10% of the Outstanding Balance (the “Extension OID”) is added to the principal amount of the Note, and the Aggregate Principal Amount is increased by the amount of the Extension OID. The “Outstanding Balance” means the total amount owing under the Note on the date of this Amendment, being the principal of $3,611,111 plus all accrued and unpaid interest and any other amounts outstanding on that date, which totals $740,060.40. The Extension OID is principal for all purposes of the Note and bears interest under Section 2 of the Note. 3. Interest. Section 2 of the Note is amended so that, beginning February 1, 2027, accrued interest is payable in cash monthly in arrears on the first Business Day of each calendar month for the preceding calendar month, with the first payment due on February 1, 2027 for January 2027. All interest accrued before January 1, 2027, including interest accrued before the date of this Amendment and interest accruing from the date of this Amendment through December 31, 2026, is payable on the Maturity Date. Failure to pay any interest under this Section 3 when due is an immediate Event of Default under Section 7(i) of the Note, without notice or cure period. 4. Extension Fee. In consideration of the extension, Maker shall pay to Payee a non-refundable extension fee of $220,000 in cash by March 31, 2027 or, if earlier, on the date the Note is repaid in full or accelerated. The Extension Fee is fully earned on the date of this Amendment. It is a fee and is in addition to, and does not reduce, the principal, interest, or any other amount owing under the Note. Until paid the Extension Fee is an obligation secured by the Collateral and guaranteed by the Pledging Stockholder. Failure to pay the Extension Fee when due is an immediate Event of Default under Section 7(i) of the Note, without notice or cure period. 5. Limited Waiver. Payee waives any Event of Default arising solely from Maker’s failure to pay the Note on the Maturity Date as in effect before this Amendment. This is not a waiver of any other Event of Default or of any right or remedy of Payee. 6. Ratification; Security. Except as expressly amended here, the Note remains unaltered and in full force and effect and is ratified and confirmed. Maker and the Pledging Stockholder each confirm that Payee has and will continue to have a valid, enforceable and perfected lien on and security interest in the Collateral, and that the Pledging Stockholder’s Guaranty extends to the Note as amended, including the Extension OID, the interest payments under Section 3 and the Extension Fee. 7. Business Combination. Neither the consummation of the transactions contemplated by the Merger Agreement, including the merger of MAC I Merger Sub Inc. with and into Maker and Maker becoming a wholly owned subsidiary of Payee, nor Payee’s deregistration as a Cayman Islands exempted company and domestication as a Nevada corporation in connection with the closing of those transactions (the “Domestication”), shall constitute an Event of Default under Section 7(v) of the Note or otherwise, or a breach of any covenant of Maker or the Pledging Stockholder under the Note. Following that Closing, the Note, as amended by this Amendment, remains outstanding and payable in accordance with its terms, and any shares of Payee issued to the Pledging Stockholder in exchange for the Pledged Shares are Pledged Shares under Section 5(b) of the Note. 8. Assignment to Sponsor. Maker and the Pledging Stockholder acknowledge and consent that Payee will assign to Melar Acquisition Sponsor I LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (“Sponsor”), all of Payee’s right, title and interest under the Note, as amended by this Amendment, including all principal (including the Extension OID), interest, the Extension Fee and other amounts then or thereafter owing, the Guaranty, the security interests in and liens on the Collateral and the Pledged Shares, and all claims and remedies of Payee (the “Assignment”), effective automatically (a) at and upon the Closing or (b) if the Closing has not occurred, on the date Payee or Sponsor notifies Maker in writing that the Assignment has occurred following the termination of the Merger Agreement or the redemption of Payee’s public shares or winding up or liquidation of Payee (the date of the Assignment, the “Assignment Date”). Upon the Assignment, (i) Sponsor shall be “Payee” for all purposes of the Note and this Amendment and shall have all rights of Payee as a permitted holder of the Note, including under Sections 4, 5 and 7 of the Note, (ii) Melar Acquisition Corp. I is released from all obligations of Payee under the Note, (iii) all payments under the Note shall be made to the account Sponsor designates in writing, and (iv) Payee shall have no obligation to make any Additional Loan. Maker and the Pledging Stockholder confirm that the Obligations are owing without any defense, setoff or counterclaim, and agree not to assert against Sponsor any defense, setoff or counterclaim that Maker or the Pledging Stockholder may have against Melar Acquisition Corp. I, including under the Merger Agreement. Maker and the Pledging Stockholder acknowledge that any guaranty of the Obligations by Melar Acquisition Corp. I in favor of Sponsor does not release or reduce any Obligation of Maker or the Pledging Stockholder. Maker and the Pledging Stockholder shall take such further actions as Sponsor reasonably requests to evidence the Assignment and to maintain the perfection and priority of Sponsor’s security interest in the Collateral, including delivering share transfer forms for the Pledged Shares in favor of Sponsor and authorizing the filing of assignments of financing statements. 9. Miscellaneous. This Amendment is governed by the law that governs the Note. This Amendment and the Note, as amended by this Amendment, are binding on and inure to the benefit of the parties and their respective successors and permitted assigns, as provided in Section 10 of the Note. Upon the Domestication and until the Assignment Date, Payee as so domesticated shall continue as “Payee” under the Note, and all rights of Payee under this Amendment and the Note, including the right to receive the Extension Fee and the security interest in the Collateral, shall continue in favor of Payee as so domesticated without any further action by any party. It may be executed in counterparts, including by electronic signature or PDF, each of which is an original and all of which together are one agreement. Headings are for convenience only. Except for Sponsor’s rights as assignee under Section 8, nothing in this Amendment confers any right, benefit or remedy on any person other than the parties to this Amendment. IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Amendment as of the date first written above. MAKER: EVERLI GLOBAL INC. PAYEE: MELAR ACQUISITION CORP. I PLEDGING STOCKHOLDER: PALELLA HOLDINGS, LLC By: /s/ Salvatore Palella By: /s/ Eric Lifshitz By: /s/ Salvatore Palella Name: Salvatore Palella Name: Eric Lifshitz Name: Salvatore Palella Title: Chief Executive Officer Title: Chief Operating Officer Title: Chief Executive Officer

title: Texas Ventures Acquisition III Corp
text: EX-10.1 2 tm2630447d1_ex10-1.htm EXHIBIT 10.1 Exhibit 10.1 THIS PROMISSORY NOTE (“NOTE”) HAS NOT BEEN REGISTERED UNDER THE SECURITIES ACT OF 1933, AS AMENDED (THE “SECURITIES ACT”). THIS NOTE HAS BEEN ACQUIRED FOR INVESTMENT ONLY AND MAY NOT BE SOLD, TRANSFERRED OR ASSIGNED IN THE ABSENCE OF REGISTRATION OF THE RESALE THEREOF UNDER THE SECURITIES ACT OR AN OPINION OF COUNSEL REASONABLY SATISFACTORY IN FORM, SCOPE AND SUBSTANCE TO THE COMPANY THAT SUCH REGISTRATION IS NOT REQUIRED. AMENDED AND RESTATED PROMISSORY NOTE November 19, 2026 Principal Amount: $290,000.00 Texas Ventures Acquisition III Corp, a Cayman Islands exempted company and blank check company (the “ Maker ”), promises to pay to the order of Yorkville Acquisition Sponsor II, LLC, a Florida limited liability company, or its registered assigns or successors in interest (the “ Payee ”), or order, the principal sum of Two Hundred Ninety Thousand Dollars ($290,000.000) in lawful money of the United States of America, on the terms and conditions described below. All payments on this Note shall be made by check or wire transfer of immediately available funds or as otherwise determined by the Maker to such account as the Payee may from time to time designate by written notice in accordance with the provisions of this Note. 1. Principal. The principal balance of this Note shall be payable by the Maker on the earlier of: (i) the date on which Maker consummates its initial business combination or (ii) the date that the winding up of the Maker is effective (such date, the “ Maturity Date ”). The principal balance may be prepaid at any time, at the election of Maker. Under no circumstances shall any individual, including but not limited to any executive officer, director, employee or stockholder of the Maker, be obligated personally for any obligations or liabilities of the Maker hereunder. 2. Interest. No interest shall accrue on the unpaid principal balance of this Note. 3. Application of Payments. All payments shall be applied first to payment in full of any costs incurred in the collection of any sum due under this Note, including (without limitation) reasonable attorney’s fees, then to the payment in full of any late charges and finally to the reduction of the unpaid principal balance of this Note. 4. Events of Default. The following shall constitute an event of default (“ Event of Default ”): (a) Failure to Make Required Payments . Failure by Maker to pay the principal amount due pursuant to this Note within five (5) business days of the date specified above. (b) Voluntary Bankruptcy, Etc . The commencement by Maker of a voluntary case under any applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization, rehabilitation or other similar law, or the consent by it to the appointment of or taking possession by a receiver, liquidator, assignee, trustee, custodian, sequestrator (or other similar official) of Maker or for any substantial part of its property, or the making by it of any assignment for the benefit of creditors, or the failure of Maker generally to pay its debts as such debts become due, or the taking of corporate action by Maker in furtherance of any of the foregoing. (c) Involuntary Bankruptcy, Etc . The entry of a decree or order for relief by a court having jurisdiction in the premises in respect of Maker in an involuntary case under any applicable bankruptcy, insolvency or other similar law, or appointing a receiver, liquidator, assignee, custodian, trustee, sequestrator (or similar official) of Maker or for any substantial part of its property, or ordering the winding-up or liquidation of its affairs, and the continuance of any such decree or order unstayed and in effect for a period of 60 consecutive days. 5. Remedies. (a) Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default specified in Section 4(a) hereof, Payee may, by written notice to Maker, declare this Note to be due immediately and payable, whereupon the unpaid principal amount of this Note, and all other amounts payable hereunder, shall become immediately due and payable without presentment, demand, protest or other notice of any kind, all of which are hereby expressly waived, anything contained herein or in the documents evidencing the same to the contrary notwithstanding. (b) Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default specified in Sections 4(b) and 4(c), the unpaid principal balance of this Note, and all other sums payable with regard to this Note, shall automatically and immediately become due and payable, in all cases without any action on the part of Payee. 6. Waivers. Maker and all endorsers and guarantors of, and sureties for, this Note waive presentment for payment, demand, notice of dishonor, protest, and notice of protest with regard to the Note, all errors, defects and imperfections in any proceedings instituted by Payee under the terms of this Note, and all benefits that might accrue to Maker by virtue of any present or future laws exempting any property, real or personal, or any part of the proceeds arising from any sale of any such property, from attachment, levy or sale under execution, or providing for any stay of execution, exemption from civil process, or extension of time for payment; and Maker agrees that any real estate that may be levied upon pursuant to a judgment obtained by virtue hereof or any writ of execution issued hereon, may be sold upon any such writ in whole or in part in any order desired by Payee. 7. Unconditional Liability. Maker hereby waives all notices in connection with the delivery, acceptance, performance, default, or enforcement of the payment of this Note, and agrees that its liability shall be unconditional, without regard to the liability of any other party, and shall not be affected in any manner by any indulgence, extension of time, renewal, waiver or modification granted or consented to by Payee, and consents to any and all extensions of time, renewals, waivers, or modifications that may be granted by Payee with respect to the payment or other provisions of this Note, and agrees that additional makers, endorsers, guarantors, or sureties may become parties hereto without notice to Maker or affecting Maker’s liability hereunder. 8. Notices. All notices, statements or other documents which are required or contemplated by this Note shall be made in writing and delivered: (i) personally or sent by first class registered or certified mail, overnight courier service or facsimile or electronic transmission to the address designated in writing, (ii) by facsimile to the number most recently provided to such party or such other address or fax number as may be designated in writing by such party or (iii) by electronic mail, to the electronic mail address most recently provided to such party or such other electronic mail address as may be designated in writing by such party. Any notice or other communication so transmitted shall be deemed to have been given on the day of delivery, if delivered personally, on the business day following receipt of written confirmation, if sent by facsimile or electronic transmission, one (1) business day after delivery to an overnight courier service or five (5) days after mailing if sent by mail. 9. Construction. THIS NOTE SHALL BE CONSTRUED AND ENFORCED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE LAWS OF DELAWARE, WITHOUT REGARD TO CONFLICT OF LAW PROVISIONS THEREOF. 10. Severability. Any provision contained in this Note which is prohibited or unenforceable in any jurisdiction shall, as to such jurisdiction, be ineffective to the extent of such prohibition or unenforceability without invalidating the remaining provisions hereof, and any such prohibition or unenforceability in any jurisdiction shall not invalidate or render unenforceable such provision in any other jurisdiction. 11. Trust Waiver . Notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary, the Payee hereby waives any and all right, title, interest or claim of any kind (“ Claim ”) in or to any distribution of or from the trust account (the “ Trust Account ”) established in connection with Maker’s initial public offering, and hereby agrees not to seek recourse, reimbursement, payment or satisfaction for any Claim against the Trust Account for any reason whatsoever; provided however that upon the consummation of the initial business combination, Maker shall repay the principal balance of this Note out of the proceeds released to Maker from the Trust Account. 12 . Amendment; Waiver . Any amendment hereto or waiver of any provision hereof may be made with, and only with, the written consent of the Maker and the Payee. 13 . Assignment . No assignment or transfer of this Note or any rights or obligations hereunder may be made by any party hereto (by operation of law or otherwise) without the prior written consent of the other party hereto and any attempted assignment without the required consent shall be void. 14. Restatement . This Note amends, restates, supersedes and replaces that certain Promissory Note dated October 20, 2026, made in the principal amount of One Hundred Forty Five Thousand Dollars ($145,000.00) by Maker, payable to Payee (the “ Prior Note ”). In connection with an additional advance of $145,000.00 made by Payee to Maker on November 19, 2026, the aggregate outstanding principal amount of this Note is Two Hundred Ninety Thousand Dollars ($290,000.00); provided, however, that the execution and delivery by the undersigned of this Note shall not, in any manner or circumstance, be deemed a payment of, a novation of or to have terminated, extinguished or discharged any of Maker’s indebtedness evidenced by the Prior Note, all of which indebtedness shall continue under and shall hereinafter be evidenced and governed by this Note. Any inconsistency between the terms of this Note and the Prior Note shall be controlled by the terms hereof. [Signature page follows] IN WITNESS WHEREOF , Maker, intending to be legally bound hereby, has caused this Note to be duly executed by the undersigned as of the day and year first above written. title: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VII
text: EX-10.1 2 ea031319801ex10-1.htm THIRD AMENDMENT TO BUSINESS COMBINATION AGREEMENT, DATED AS OF NOVEMBER 22, 2026, BY AND AMONG INFLECTION POINT ACQUISITION CORP. VII, IPGX MERGER SUB, INC. AND ELROY AIR, INC Exhibit 10.1 THIRD AMENDMENT TO BUSINESS COMBINATION AGREEMENT This Third Amendment to Business Combination Agreement (this “ Amendment ”), is made and entered into as of November 22, 2026, by and among (i) Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VII, a Cayman Islands exempted company (which shall transfer by way of continuation and domesticate as a Delaware corporation prior to Closing) (the “ Purchaser ”), (ii) IPGX Merger Sub, Inc., a Delaware corporation and wholly-owned subsidiary of the Purchaser (“ Merger Sub ”), and (iii) Elroy Air, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the “ Company ”). The Purchaser, Merger Sub and the Company are sometimes referred to herein individually as a “ Party ” and, collectively, as the “ Parties .” RECITALS: WHEREAS , reference is hereby made to that certain Business Combination Agreement, dated June 26, 2026, by and among the Purchaser, Merger Sub and the Company (as amended by that certain First Amendment to Business Combination Agreement, dated as of October 27, 2026 and that certain Second Amendment to Business Combination Agreement dated as of November 11, 2026, collectively, the “ Business Combination Agreement ”); WHEREAS , pursuant to Section 9.10 (Amendment; Waiver) of the Business Combination Agreement, the Business Combination Agreement may be amended, supplemented or modified only by execution of a written instrument signed by the Purchaser and the Company; WHEREAS , on November 12, 2026, the Company issued to Barq Electric Holdings Ltd, a limited liability company organized and existing under the laws of the United Arab Emirates (“ Barq ”), a warrant to purchase 5,000,000 shares of the Company Common Stock (the “ Company Barq Warrant ”), and the Parties desire that the Company Barq Warrant be assumed by the Purchaser upon consummation of the Business Combination; and WHEREAS , in accordance with Section 9.10 (Amendment; Waiver) of the Business Combination Agreement, the Parties desire to further amend the Business Combination Agreement as set forth in this Amendment. NOW, THEREFORE , in consideration of the covenants, promises and representations set forth herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows: ARTICLE I AMENDMENTS 1.1. Amendments . The Parties hereby agree that the Business Combination Agreement shall be amended and/or modified as follows: (a) Section 2.02 (Consideration) . Section 2.02(d) and (e) of the Business Combination Agreement is hereby amended and restated in its entirety to read as follows: “(d) All Other Company Securities. The aggregate consideration to be paid to holders of all other equity interests of the Company in, or in connection with, the Merger (for the avoidance of doubt, other than the Pre-Funded Convertible Notes, the Company Pre-Funded Convertible Note Investor Warrants and the Company Barq Warrant) shall be the Aggregate Common Stock Base Consideration. The consideration to be paid in, or in connection with, the Merger in respect of each share of Company Common Stock that is issued and outstanding, or deemed to be issued and outstanding after giving effect to the conversion described in Section 2.01 and including all shares of Company Common Stock deemed to be issued and outstanding pursuant to Section 2.03 immediately prior to the Effective Time, shall be a number of shares of Domesticated Purchaser Common Stock equal to the Per Share Base Consideration. (e) Aggregate Earn-out Consideration . Subject to the vesting and forfeiture conditions specified in Section 2.09 , the Eligible Stockholders shall be entitled to receive, in the aggregate, the Aggregate Earn-out Consideration, allocated among them in accordance with their respective Pro Rata Shares. The earnout consideration to be paid in, or in connection with, the Merger in respect of each share included in the Company Fully Diluted Capital shall be, subject to the vesting and forfeiture conditions specified in Section 2.09 , the right to receive, upon each Triggering Event (or any issuance pursuant to Section 2.09(b) ), a number of shares of Domesticated Purchaser Common Stock equal to the quotient of (A) the product of the Pro Rata Share of the Eligible Stockholder holding such share multiplied by the number of Earnout Shares then issuable, divided by (B) the aggregate number of shares included in the Company Fully Diluted Capital that are attributable to such Eligible Stockholder as of immediately prior to the Effective Time (or, in the case of Domesticated Purchaser Series A Preferred Stock issued pursuant to Section 2.02(a) , all shares of Domesticated Purchaser Common Stock that are issuable to such Eligible Stockholder upon a hypothetical conversion of such Domesticated Purchaser Series A Preferred Stock at the time of the applicable Triggering Event or issuance pursuant to Section 2.09(b) ) (the “ Per Share Earn-out Consideration ”). For purposes of this Section 2.02(e) and the definitions of “Company Fully Diluted Capital” and “Pro Rata Share,” each reference to the “applicable Triggering Event” shall include any issuance pursuant to Section 2.09(b) . (b) Section 2.02 (Consideration ). Section 2.02 of the Business Combination Agreement is hereby further amended by adding a new paragraph (f) to read as follows: “(f) Company Barq Warrant Consideration . The consideration to be paid in, or in connection with, the Merger to Barq in respect of the Company Barq Warrant shall be a warrant to purchase, on a one-for-one basis, a number of shares of Domesticated Purchaser Common Stock equal to the number of shares of Company Common Stock subject to the Company Barq Warrant immediately prior to the Effective Time, at an exercise price per share equal to the exercise price per share of the Company Barq Warrant immediately prior to the Effective Time and otherwise on substantially the same terms and conditions as applied to the Company Barq Warrant immediately prior to the Effective Time (the “ Company Barq Warrant Consideration ”). Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, (i) neither the Company Barq Warrant nor any shares of Company Common Stock issued upon exercise of the Company Barq Warrant (whether before or after the Effective Time) shall be included in the Company Fully Diluted Capital or taken into account in determining any Pro Rata Share, (ii) Barq shall not be an Eligible Stockholder in respect of the Company Barq Warrant or any such shares, and (iii) none of the Company Barq Warrant, the Company Barq Warrant Consideration or any such shares shall entitle Barq or any of its successors or assigns to any portion of the Aggregate Earn-out Consideration or the Per Share Earn-out Consideration.” 2 (c) Section 2.03 (Conversion of Securities) . Section 2.03 of the Business Combination Agreement is hereby amended by adding a new paragraph (e) to read as follows: “(e) Effect on Company Barq Warrant . At the Effective Time, by virtue of the Merger and without any action on the part of the Purchaser, Merger Sub, the Company or any holder of the Company Barq Warrant, the Company Barq Warrant, to the extent outstanding and unexercised immediately prior to the Effective Time, shall automatically be assumed by the Purchaser and converted into the right to receive the Company Barq Warrant Consideration.” (d) Section 10.01 (Certain Definitions) . Section 10.01 of the Business Combination Agreement is hereby amended by (i) deleting definition “Earn-out Exchange Ratio”, (ii) adding the following defined terms in the appropriate alphabetical order and (iii) amending and restating the following defined terms in their entirety as follows: “ Aggregate Base Consideration ” means the number of shares of Domesticated Purchaser Common Stock equal to the quotient of: (a) (i) the Base Purchase Price, minus (ii) the Closing Indebtedness except as set forth in Schedule 10-A of the Company Disclosure Letter, in each case excluding any Indebtedness incurred pursuant to the Pre-Funded Note Investment, divided by (b) the Redemption Price. “ Common Stock Exchange Ratio ” means (a) with respect to the Company Preferred Stock for the purposes of the Preferred Stock As-Converted Exchange pursuant to Section 2.03(a)(iii)(B) , the Aggregate Base Consideration divided by the Pre-Closing Company Fully Diluted Capital and (b) with respect to all other Company Securities, the Aggregate Common Stock Base Consideration divided by the Company Adjusted Fully Diluted Capital. “ Company Adjusted Fully Diluted Capital ” means the sum (without duplication) of the aggregate number of (i) shares of Company Common Stock that are issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time, assuming and after giving effect to the conversion of all Company Convertible Securities (other than the Pre-Funded Convertible Notes) pursuant to Section 2.01(a) , (ii) all shares of Company Common Stock issuable upon full exercise of all issued and outstanding Company Warrants, other than the Company Pre-Funded Convertible Note Investor Warrants (calculated using the treasury method of accounting on a cashless exercise basis), (iii) the maximum number of shares of Company Common Stock issuable upon full exercise of all Vested Company Options outstanding as of immediately prior to the Effective Time, (iv) the maximum number of shares of Company Common Stock issuable upon full exercise of all Unvested Company Options, which are not the Signing-Date Unvested Company Options, that remain outstanding as of immediately prior to the Effective Time, and (v) all shares underlying the Company RSUs, whether vested or unvested, outstanding as of immediately prior to the Effective Time. 3 “ Company Barq Warrant ” means that certain warrant to purchase 5,000,000 shares of Company Common Stock, issued by the Company to Barq Electric Holdings Ltd, a limited liability company organized and existing under the laws of the United Arab Emirates (“ Barq ”), on November 12, 2026. “ Company Convertible Security ” means each convertible promissory note, simple agreement for future equity or similar instrument or Contract issued by the Company or entered into by the Company pursuant to which any Person has the right to convert or exchange such instrument or Contract into equity securities of the Company (for the avoidance of doubt, excluding Company Warrants, the Company Barq Warrant, Company Options and Company RSUs). “ Company Fully Diluted Capital ” means the sum (without duplication) of the aggregate number of (i) shares of Company Common Stock that are issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time, assuming and after giving effect to the conversion of all Company Convertible Securities (other than the Pre-Funded Convertible Notes) pursuant to Section 2.01 , (ii) shares of Company Preferred Stock that are issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time, assuming and after giving effect to the conversion of all Company Convertible Securities (other than the Pre-Funded Convertible Notes) pursuant to Section 2.01 , (iii) all shares of Company Common Stock and Company Preferred Stock issuable upon full exercise of all issued and outstanding Company Warrants, including the Company Pre-Funded Convertible Note Investor Warrants (calculated using the treasury method of accounting on a cashless exercise basis), (iv) all shares of Company Common Stock issuable upon full exercise of all Vested Company Options outstanding as of immediately prior to the Effective Time (calculated using the treasury method of accounting on a cashless exercise basis), (v) all shares of Domesticated Purchaser Common Stock that are issuable upon a hypothetical conversion, at the time of the applicable Triggering Event, of Domesticated Purchaser Series A Preferred Stock issued pursuant to Section 2.02(a) of this Agreement and (vi) all shares of Company Common Stock that are issuable under the Specified RSUs as set forth in Schedule 10-D. “ Company Warrants ” means all warrants to purchase any shares or other equity interests of the Company, other than the Company Barq Warrant. “ Pre-Closing Company Fully Diluted Capital ” means the sum (without duplication) of the aggregate number of (i) shares of Company Common Stock that are issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time, assuming and after giving effect to the conversion of all Company Convertible Securities (other than the Pre-Funded Convertible Notes) pursuant to Section 2.01 , (ii) shares of Company Common Stock into which the shares of the Company Preferred Stock that are issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time are convertible, determined on an as-converted to Company Common Stock basis, assuming and after giving effect to the conversion of all Company Convertible Securities (other than the Pre-Funded Convertible Notes) pursuant to Section 2.01 , (iii) all shares of Company Common Stock and Company Preferred Stock (with such Company Preferred Stock determined on an as-converted to Company Common Stock basis) issuable upon full exercise of all issued and outstanding Company Warrants, other than the Company Pre-Funded Convertible Note Investor Warrants (calculated using the treasury method of accounting on a cashless exercise basis), (iv) the maximum number of shares of Company Common Stock issuable upon full exercise of all Vested Company Options outstanding as of immediately prior to the Effective Time, (v) the maximum number of shares of Company Common Stock issuable upon full exercise of all Unvested Company Options, which are not the Signing-Date Unvested Company Options, that remain outstanding as of immediately prior to the Effective Time, and (vi) all shares of Company Common Stock issuable upon settlement of the Company RSUs (whether vested or unvested) outstanding as of immediately prior to the Effective Time. 4 (e) Section 4.03(a) and Section 4.03(b)(ii) of the Company Disclosure Letter are hereby replaced with Schedule 4.03 attached to this Amendment. (f) Section 7.03 (Conditions to Obligations of the Purchaser and Merger Sub) . Section 7.03(d)(iii)(D) of the Business Combination Agreement (as amended and restated by the First Amendment and Second Amendment) is hereby amended and restated in its entirety to read as follows: “(D) A copy of the Seller Lock-Up Agreement, duly executed by (i) each holder of equity securities of the Company who, together with all other Affiliates of such holder, will receive, or would receive upon exercise of the Exchanged Options or settlement of the Purchaser RSUs, at least 0.15% of the Aggregate Base Consideration, and (ii) each employee of the Company who will continue to be employed by the Company or the Purchaser following the Closing, regardless of the portion of the Aggregate Base Consideration such holder will or would receive;” (g) Exhibit E-2 . Exhibit E-2 of the Business Combination Agreement is hereby amended and restated in its entirety to incorporate Exhibit E-2 listed as Exhibit A to this Amendment. 1.2. Effect of Amendments . The Parties hereby acknowledge and agree that this Amendment and the amendments set out in Section 1.1 above shall be effective as of the date hereof. This Amendment is supplemental to the Business Combination Agreement and is to be read and construed as one instrument with the Business Combination Agreement. On and after the date hereof, each reference in the Business Combination Agreement or the Ancillary Documents to the provisions amended pursuant to Section 1.1 above shall be a reference to the respective provision as amended hereby, and each reference to the Business Combination Agreement in the Ancillary Documents shall be a reference to the Business Combination Agreement as amended hereby. The Business Combination Agreement, as amended by this Amendment, is and shall continue to be in full force and effect and is in all respects ratified and confirmed hereby. This Amendment shall not constitute an amendment or waiver of any provision of the Business Combination Agreement or the Ancillary Documents not expressly amended or waived herein and shall not be construed as an amendment, waiver, or consent to any action that would require an amendment, waiver, or consent except as expressly stated herein. This Amendment is without prejudice to any rights or claims of any Party arising under the terms of the Business Combination Agreement or other Ancillary Documents before the date of this Amendment. 5 ARTICLE II GENERAL PROVISIONS 2.1. Counterparts . This Amendment may be executed and delivered (including by facsimile, email or other electronic transmission) in one or more counterparts, and by the different Parties in separate counterparts, each of which when executed shall be deemed to be an original but all of which taken together shall constitute one and the same agreement. 2.2. Entire Agreement . The following provisions in the Business Combination Agreement are incorporated by reference herein and shall apply mutatis mutandis with respect to the subject matter of this Amendment: Section 9.02 (Notices), Section 9.03 (Binding Effect; Assignment), Section 9.04 (Third Parties), Section 9.05 (Governing Law), Section 9.06 (Jurisdiction), Section 9.07 (Waiver of Jury Trial), Section 9.08 (Specific Performance), Section 9.09 (Severability), and Section 9.10 (Amendment; Waiver).
